# GivenWhenLab

An open-source lab exploring behavior-driven development, test automation, and the research behind better software tests.

Scope: GivenWhenLab connects research and practice in Behavior-Driven Development, Gherkin, automated testing, empirical software engineering, developer tools, and experiments with AI applied to software testing.
Focus: Readable specifications; Reliable automation; Developer tooling; Experiments and research

## Publications
